system.description: After you perform an invocation during a conflict, you and up to one ally you can see each increase one Attribute's die size by one, to a maximum of d12, until the end of the scene or until you use this again. The Attribute follows the wellspring: air → Insight, earth → any Attribute of your choice, fire → Dexterity, lightning → Might, water → Willpower. Held by the standing rulings rather than a bespoke one: die raises never stack and d12 is the ceiling everywhere, and Guise bonuses sit outside p.266's two-effect cap — so this is one raise, on a class ability, with the mask's +3 not counted against it. Still the only skill in the class that hands a scene-long raise to somebody else; watch it in play.
